versions.changelog:
Initial release of the ai-image-prompt skill.

- Translates user needs into precise, high-quality AI image prompts, with robust support for product, model, and e-commerce scenarios.
- Features strict reference mapping (role assignment), high-fidelity recreation, and detailed task mode routing for compliance, realism, and style matching.
- Implements customized prompt enhancement layers (detail, texture, quality), safety rewriting for policy compliance, and Chinese/English prompt output packages.
- Integrates step-by-step guides for spatial layout, brand tone, deliverable formats (main image, gallery, detail page, multi-view), and specific handling for fitted apparel.
- Outputs complete, actionable prompt bundles and supports structured JSON output for further automation.
